items.workingTitle: What Are Sight Words? Dolch vs Fry Lists Explained
items.angle: Answer the question in the opening: sight words are common words kids learn to read at a glance, and some don't follow the usual phonics rules. Then compare the two public-domain lists: Dolch (grouped by grade level, pre-primer to third grade, plus nouns) and Fry (the most common words in frequency order, in groups of 100). Say which a school might use and that it varies, how many words to expect per grade, and how to practice (read, trace, find in books). Link the grade-level sight word pages for each list. The 'list of sight words for preschool' keyword now belongs to /sight-words/pre-k/.
